notes: Overview: Large European payments processor evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for production LLM inference. Heavy emphasis on customer-managed keys and auditability. Primary workloads: realtime chat agent for merchant support, transaction doc search, embedding-based matching, and reranking of risk signals.

Security ask (high priority): must support AWS KMS + CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault + Dedicated HSM, GCP KMS, and an on-prem BYOK flow to onboard hardware HSM (Thales/Entrust). Customer calls this the 'KMS/HSM matrix' and expects sample key lifecycle docs.

Desired key model: envelope encryption with CEK stored in customer-managed KMS; Redwood holds encrypted CEKs only. Rotation policy: 90-day rotation for CEKs and annual rotation for root keys. Customer requires ability to rotate without redeploying model artifacts.

HSM integration details from last call: Cedarway security team prefers integrating via PKCS#11 for their on-prem HSM; asked if Redwood Private supports HSM-backed wrapping keys and local KMS proxies. SE notes: Redwood supports AWS KMS/EKS + CloudHSM for envelope keys; need to validate PKCS#11 passthrough and azure dedicated-hsm mapping.

Audit & telemetry: Full key-operation audit trail required (creation, use, rotation, deletion) with export to their SIEM (Splunk). They require immutable audit logs for 7 years and real-time syslog forwarding. Also requested token-level request traces mapped to API keys and service-IDs.

Data residency: Primary region EU-West; logs and model cache must be kept in EU datacenter. Redwood Private will run inside their AWS VPC but they may run a hybrid with on-prem inference nodes for ultra-sensitive flows.

Compliance: Cedarway needs SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence for any managed components and wants sample penetration test reports. For Private deployment they will accept Redwood attestations plus a 3rd-party security assessment on the VPC package.

POC plan (agreed): 1) Security scoping (done) 2) Deliverable: VPC sandbox with KMS integration using customer dev AWS account (target: 2 weeks) 3) Demonstrate envelope encryption and KMS rotation without downtime 4) HSM proof-of-concept: test wrapping with a customer Thales HSM in their lab (target: +4 weeks) 5) Performance baseline for 99th percentile latency with KV-cache enabled.
